wwo.name: Kyoto
wwo.method: The 1889 survey connects Shijo Karasuma and Nishiki to the Kamo crossing, Gion and the early Maruyama park. Streets from Shijo continue along Karasuma and the north palace boundary to the textile quarter at Nishijin. The Toji and southern rail fringe are outside the traced candidate. Untraced streets keep the fallback.

registration.reference: Affine registration against four matched tiles of a georeferenced copy of the same 1892 edition. Intermediate pixels are Web Mercator z16. GeoJSON is CRS84.
registration.precision_limit: Fit residual applies only within the overlap. The central and western parts of the corridor use affine extrapolation. The fit is to another copy of the map. Positional and apparent construction dimensions are approximate. Nishijin and the Karasuma connector use the same edition on additional scan crops west and north of the overlap. The affine residual is not a measured error for these additions.
